preservedResponsibilities: AQF9AG ports DateTime EMPTY, Date, Time, combined, copy and UNO constructors, UNO output and the original Duration-backed Sub dispatch. TypeScript projects C++ multiple inheritance as the existing Date base and one owned Time subobject; copying remains by value and forwarded time getters/setters mutate that subobject. The equal-packed-time branch subtracts native normalized Date days; differing times use the original Duration order. No floating epoch subtraction or host Date backend is substituted. Platform/system-clock constructors, date-time arithmetic, timezone conversion and platform file-date APIs remain unported. Tests verify nanosecond cancellation at midnight, reverse subtraction and independent copies.
